engine.notLoaded: Shown when the shared service is unavailable.
devices.off: Device list body while Nearby is off. The header already says it is off, so this says what to do, like the native Bluetooth panel.
folder.saveTo: Receive folder action or validation. %1 = display name of receive folder.
folder.saveToTooltip: Receive folder action or validation. %1 = full receive folder path.
folder.useDownloadsTooltip: Receive folder action or validation. %1 = custom receive folder path.
chooser.sendFiles: Native file chooser title or launch error.
chooser.sendFolder: Native file chooser title or launch error.
chooser.saveTo: Native file chooser title or launch error.
chooser.notStarted: Native file chooser title or launch error.
chooser.notOpened: Native file chooser title or launch error.
clipboard.imageFailed: Error when Send clipboard cannot save the picture (for example a screenshot) on the clipboard to send it.
helper.repairMissing: Helper recovery/version panel. %1 = literal update command.
helper.versions: Helper recovery/version panel. %1 = required version; %2 = installed version.
helper.unavailableDetail: Helper recovery/version panel. %1 = translated Retry helper label; %2 = literal ./build.sh command.
incoming.wantsToSend: Incoming approval prompt. %1 = remote sender alias.
incoming.moreRequests: Incoming approval prompt. %1 = localized count of queued requests.
transfer.message: Name of a received text message where a file name would go, in the request summary and its notification. The message content itself is never put there.
transfer.andMore: Transfer summary/progress/result. %1 = first remote filename; %2 = localized remaining file count.
transfer.progressTo: Transfer summary/progress/result. %1 = localized percentage without percent sign; %2 = destination alias.
transfer.progressFrom: Transfer summary/progress/result. %1 = localized percentage without percent sign; %2 = sender alias.
transfer.speed: Second progress line under the percentage while sending or receiving. %1 is a formatted size such as 12 MB, so %1/s is a speed; %2 is a duration from the transfer.fewSeconds, transfer.seconds, transfer.minutes or transfer.hoursMinutes entries.
transfer.fewSeconds: Time left in a transfer, used as %2 of transfer.speed, when under ten seconds remain.
transfer.seconds: Time left in a transfer, used as %2 of transfer.speed. %1 is a number of seconds. Use the short unit symbol so no plural form is needed.
transfer.minutes: Time left in a transfer, used as %2 of transfer.speed. %1 is a number of minutes. Use the short unit symbol so no plural form is needed.
transfer.hoursMinutes: Time left in a transfer, used as %2 of transfer.speed. %1 is hours and %2 minutes. Use short unit symbols so no plural form is needed.
status.startingReceiver: Short receiver/transfer state or explanatory error.
status.turnedOff: Short receiver/transfer state or explanatory error.
status.ready: Short receiver/transfer state or explanatory error.
status.readyToReceive: Short receiver/transfer state or explanatory error.
status.lookingNearby: Short receiver/transfer state or explanatory error.
status.scanning: Short receiver/transfer state or explanatory error.
status.pinRequired: Short receiver/transfer state or explanatory error.
status.pinEnabled: Short receiver/transfer state or explanatory error.
status.pinDisabled: Short receiver/transfer state or explanatory error.
status.incomingTransfer: Short receiver/transfer state or explanatory error.
status.textReceived: Short receiver/transfer state or explanatory error.
status.declined: Short receiver/transfer state or explanatory error.
status.received: Short receiver/transfer state or explanatory error.
status.sent: Short receiver/transfer state or explanatory error.
status.transferFailed: Short receiver/transfer state or explanatory error.
failure.rateLimited: Transfer error shown in the panel: the receiver blocked further attempts after wrong PINs.
failure.offerTooLarge: Transfer error shown in the panel: the list of files to send is too large for the protocol. Keep 2 MiB.
failure.tooManyFiles: Transfer error shown in the panel: more than 10,000 files were selected. Format the number for the language.
failure.tooDeep: Transfer error shown in the panel: a selected folder nests more than 32 folders deep.
failure.unsafePath: Transfer error shown in the panel: a file path uses hidden items, unsafe characters or is too long.
failure.invalidEncoding: Transfer error shown in the panel: a file name uses bytes that are not valid UTF-8. Keep UTF-8.
failure.noFiles: Transfer error shown in the panel: the selected folders are empty.
failure.unsupportedEntry: Transfer error shown in the panel: a selected folder holds something that is not a regular file, such as a device file.
failure.permissionDenied: Transfer error shown in the panel: the system refused access to a file or folder.
failure.unreadable: Transfer error shown in the panel: some selected files or folders could not be read.
failure.portInUse: Transfer error shown in the panel: another program already uses the LocalSend network port.
failure.deviceUnavailable: Transfer error shown in the panel: the other device could not be reached.
failure.timedOut: Transfer error shown in the panel: the transfer stopped because the other side did not answer in time.
failure.declined: Transfer error shown in the panel: the person on the other device declined the transfer.
failure.pinRequired: Transfer error shown in the panel: the receiving device asks for a PIN.
failure.networkUnavailable: Transfer error shown in the panel: the computer has no usable network.
failure.busy: Transfer error shown in the panel: a send was started while another one is still running.
failure.invalidPin: Transfer error shown in the panel: the PIN typed for the receiving device has characters it cannot accept.
failure.textTooLarge: Transfer error shown in the panel: clipboard text over 1 MiB cannot be sent. Keep 1 MiB.
failure.internal: Transfer error shown in the panel: an internal fault between Nearby's panel and its helper.
failure.diskFull: Receive error shown in the panel: the disk ran out of space while saving received files.
failure.integrityFailed: Receive error shown in the panel: a received file did not match what the sender announced.

status.couldNotStartFolderDetail: Short receiver/transfer state or explanatory error. %1 = receive folder path; %2 = translated Use Downloads label.
status.receiverStopped: Short receiver/transfer state or explanatory error.

status.restarting: Short receiver/transfer state or explanatory error.

notify.incomingBody: Desktop notification body. Remote arguments are escaped before substitution. %1 = escaped sender alias; %2 = escaped file summary.
notify.textBody: Desktop notification body. Remote arguments are escaped before substitution. %1 = escaped sender alias.
